name: Jira Story Triage
description: Review Jira work items for readiness (using the agent-execution readiness bar — five questions for coding-agent or engineer handoff), explain why each weak item is not ready (which question failed and the specific gap), surface unresolved human questions that must be answered before improvement, draft proposed rewrites and acceptance criteria, and write back to Jira only after the user approves the exact payload. Read-only until approval; the write flow is opt-in, per-item, shows old/new values, lists protected fields, and reports partial failures with a recovery path. Triggers on 'which stories are not ready', 'which stories need more detail', 'improve these weak stories', 'make tickets actionable', 'draft better acceptance criteria', 'explain why these items are not ready'. For team backlog status and pick-up hand-off (ready/blocked/unassigned/stand-up), use jira-team-status.

deps._runtime_contract: Sibling skills are addressed BY NAME at runtime. The agent's harness resolves the name to whatever install location the user picked. `source` below is install guidance only — never a runtime path.

skills.name: jira
skills.purpose: All Jira reads: check, search (for the JQL scope), get-issue (image-content confirmation). Also the conditional update-issue call in the improve flow — invoked once per item only after the user approves the exact drafted payload. Hard dependency — there is no degraded path without it.

input.arguments: A JQL expression, a sprint/board scope, or a project key (defaults to open sprints). Optionally a repo URL or name for grounding.

artifacts: A read-only readiness review header (scope, items reviewed, Jira-not-changed confirmation) followed by a reason-first Markdown table: one row per item with outcome (Ready for agent execution / Gated / Not ready — needs shaping / Needs detail), complexity for Ready items, 'Why not ready' column (failed Q + specific gap), and 'Unresolved human questions'. Footer with counts and Jira-not-changed confirmation. Followed by an opt-in improve flow: surfaces unresolved human questions first, then drafts per-item payload (with expected readiness after draft), shows old/new values and protected fields, confirms before any write, reports partial failures with recovery action.
